website.description: Operator or listing URL. Not a scrape-target instruction.

phone_public.description: Public business phone as published by the operator.

notes_original.description: Short original research note only. Never paste copyrighted prose or photo URLs destined for publish fields.

source_url.description: Primary provenance: http(s) URL or repo-relative path.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this record (seed conversion or later fetch).

licence.description: How we may use the captured facts (e.g. internal-research). Not a grant to republish third-party copy.

raw_refs.description: Extra source URLs or repo paths (starter table, aggregators).
